title: Vietnamese Culinary Culture
summary: Vietnamese: fish sauce and lime, rice noodles, oil.
origins: Vietnamese cuisine reflects asia geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Balance of sweet, sour, salty, spicy, and umami in every bite.
teaching: High heat for wok hei, fish sauce or soy for umami, fresh herbs at the very end.
Soy, ginger, garlic, rice, and a hot wok or large skillet.
Signature pairing: fish sauce and lime + rice noodles + oil.
